name: blazwitcher-raycast
title: Blazwitcher
description: Search Chrome tabs, bookmarks, and history with Chinese, Pinyin, initials, and English.
author: julian0197

commands.name: search-all
commands.title: Search Browser
commands.subtitle: Blazwitcher
commands.description: Search Chrome tabs, bookmarks, and history with fuzzy Pinyin matching.

preferences.name: searchStrategy
preferences.title: Search Mode
preferences.description: Match titles and domains using the Blazwitcher Chrome extension's ranking. Full URL Search also includes paths, query parameters, and fragments, while keeping title matches first.

preferences.name: historyDays
preferences.title: History Date Range (Days)
preferences.description: Read the last 14 days by default, matching the Blazwitcher Chrome extension. Enter 0 to include all dates.

preferences.name: historyLimit
preferences.title: History Reading Limit
preferences.description: Read the most recently visited records first. The default is 1,000, matching the Blazwitcher Chrome extension. Maximum: 100,000.

preferences.name: historyDisplayCount
preferences.title: History Result Count
preferences.description: Maximum history results per search, including Top Suggestions. Range: 1–20. Default: 10.

preferences.name: bookmarkDisplayCount
preferences.title: Bookmark Result Count
preferences.description: Maximum bookmark results per search, including Top Suggestions. Range: 1–20. Default: 10.

preferences.name: topSuggestionsCount
preferences.title: Top Suggestions
preferences.description: Move the highest-ranked matches into Top Suggestions when a query is entered. Range: 1–10. Default: 2. This does not add results.

preferences.name: enableConsecutiveSearch
preferences.title: Strict Search (Consecutive English Matches)
preferences.label: Require consecutive English-character matches
preferences.description: Off by default. When enabled, rct no longer matches React. Chinese Pinyin and initials are still supported.

preferences.name: startupPreview
preferences.title: Startup Cache
preferences.label: Show cached results while fresh data loads
preferences.description: Cache up to 100 bookmarks and 100 history records per Chrome profile locally for five minutes. Tabs and incognito data are excluded. Disable to stop using the cache.

preferences.name: includeIncognito
preferences.title: Incognito Tabs
preferences.label: Include tabs from incognito windows
preferences.description: Read incognito tabs in memory only. They are never written to history or the startup cache.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('Publish this extension through the Raycast CLI. Use npm run publish instead of npm publish.'); process.exit(1)"
